string-array.name: info_whats_new_items
string-array.item: Start screen fits small and zoomed phones; scrolling folds the radar and status strip
Three unused permissions removed; privacy texts name every network use
Screen readers no longer reach the start screen under an open page
Fewer false alarms: stricter reading of trace lists, URLs and DNS names
Known-good list now also covers Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO system files
Setup guides show the words to look for in Settings in bold
